Farhan Chauhan
Senior Accountant | Bangalore
farhan.chauhan990@example.com | +91 9287747463

Detail-oriented accounting professional with experience in retail and financial services environments. Strong track record of improving compliance and month-end close processes through disciplined reconciliation and reporting. Comfortable working cross-functionally to implement controls and automate routine tasks.

Experience
Quanta Retail — Jan 2026 - Present
Senior Accountant (On-site)
- Managed GST return preparation and filing for 120+ GSTINs, reducing late submissions by 75% and recovering Rs. 6.2L in input tax credits through reconciliations using MS Excel.
- Performed TDS calculations, monthly deposits and quarterly filings, improving TDS compliance accuracy to 99% and cutting vendor query resolution time by 40%.
- Streamlined month-end closing using advanced Microsoft Excel models (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, macros) to shorten close cycle from 12 to 6 days while maintaining audit-ready schedules.

Dream11 — Jul 2021 - Dec 2025
Accounts Manager (Hybrid)
- Led GST accounting and compliance for multiple business units, coordinated assessments and audits, and implemented revised invoicing controls that reduced GST mismatches by 60%.
- Managed accounting operations in Tally for expense and vendor ledgers, migrating 18 legacy company entities and ensuring timely reconciliations and supplier payments.
- Prepared periodic MIS and variance reports in MS Excel to support finance leadership decisions; identified cost-saving opportunities that lowered operating expenses by 4% annually.

Saffron Bank — Oct 2020 - Jun 2021
Accounts Manager (On-site)
- Maintained general ledger and performed monthly reconciliations using Tally and Excel, closing books within 8 days consistently during tenure.
- Created automated Excel templates and bank reconciliation workflows that cut manual effort by 50% and improved transaction traceability.
- Coordinated statutory filings and supported internal audits with organized documentation and Confluence pages for process knowledge.

Projects
- Accounts Automation Templates — Developed a set of MS Excel templates and macros for recurring reconciliations and GST summary preparation adopted across teams to reduce manual effort by ~35%.
- Finance Knowledge Base — Built a Confluence space consolidating accounting procedures, checklists and filing schedules, improving onboarding speed for new hires.

Skills
Accounting Tools: Tally, GST, TDS
Analysis & Office: MS Excel, Confluence
Technical & Workflow: Git, Linux

Education
B.Com, Narsee Monjee College

Notice period: 60 days
